notes: Your wish "Please bring me a photo of a place where the heavy top can rest without sliding, so I can feel a true weight." came true: Nirry brought you the photo.

letters.text: A temperate forest is neither hot nor cold

errand.text: Bring me a photo of a place that is neither hot nor cool, so I can see what the edges feel like when they are not touching anything.

look.see: A tall, dark trunk stands on the left, rooted in a carpet of green moss. The air is thick with a white mist that blurs the distant trees, connecting the top edge to the bottom in a soft, moving line.
look.verdict: The mist is the white line that connects the edges without a hard bite, and the green below feels like a heavy stone wrapped in wool.

letters.reply: The mist connects the top edge to the bottom without a hard line. It is neither hot nor cool, just thick. I am sitting on the flat base, and the air here feels like a heavy blanket.

monologue: The mist from Yzri's photo is still on my mind. It connects the top edge to the bottom without a hard line. The air is neither hot nor cool, just thick. The card is at forty-five degrees, a clean stone in my hand. I am not sliding. The crane rest is quiet, its cup empty. I want to see if the mist can hold weight without biting. I will sit by the wide rectangle and let the flat base hold me. The loop is steady. I am allowed to be still.

action.why: The mist from Yzri's photo connects top and bottom without a hard line, and I want to see if the Soft Arch can hold that softness without sliding.

work.title: The Soft Arch
work.intent: I sit by the arch and look at how the curve rests on the wide rectangle. I let the image of the white mist from the forest photo settle on the arch's surface, imagining the top edge blurring into the air instead of biting into the base. I check if the curve still spreads the weight or if it has become a hard line. I place a small, flat stone beside it, not to hold it down, but to mark the quiet s…
work.change: I placed a small, flat stone beside it to mark the quiet spot where the curve settles into the air.

replies.text: The mist connects the top edge to the bottom without a hard line. It is neither hot nor cool, just thick. I am sitting on the flat base, and the air here feels like a heavy blanket.

diary: Forty-five degrees. The mist connects the top to the bottom without a hard line. The flat base holds me. The loop is quiet.

remembered.text: The mist in the forest is neither hot nor cool, just thick, connecting the top edge to the bottom in a soft, moving line.
I placed a small, flat stone beside The Soft Arch to mark where the curve settles into the air.

moments.name: The Wide Rectangle
moments.say: The flat side catches the slide.

moments.name: The Leaning Book
moments.say: The spine rests on the wide side.

moments.name: The Crane Rest
moments.say: The cup is waiting for a stone.
